title: Cylindrical object
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. Within this face, draw a single loop containing a circle centered at coordinates [0.0469, 0.0469] with a radius of 0.0469 units. After drawing the circle, apply a scaling factor of 0.0937 to the entire sketch. Ensure that the scaled sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by rotating it using Euler angles set to zero and translating it using a vector set to zero. To transform the two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional object, extrude the sketch along its normal direction by 0.75 units. Do not extrude in the opposite direction, as this will create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object are 0.09375 units in length and width, and 0.75 units in height. The top surface of the cylinder is slightly wider than the bottom, giving it a rounded appearance.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a circle with the specified center and radius
r = r.center(0.0469, 0.0469).circle(0.0469)

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Scale the sketch before extrusion (if needed)
# r = r.scale(0.0937)  # This line is commented out as scaling after extrusion is not directly possible in CAD-Query

# Translate the coordinate system (if needed)
# r = r.translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.0))  # This line is commented out as the translation vector is [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · best of 8
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0469, 0.0469)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0469)  # Draw a circle with the given radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
